en.summary: Fixes the simulator SV39 page-table model by zero-initializing newly allocated root and intermediate page-table pages before installing valid PTEs.
why_it_counts: The patch changes the modeled virtual-memory behavior of the simulator, not just logging or diagnostics.
Without zero initialization, stale bytes in newly allocated page-table pages can be misread as valid PTEs.
The modified files are the simulator memory model and backing page storage implementation.
disqualifiers: The same commit also adds logging and assert checks, but those are secondary to the page-table initialization fix.
evidence: memory.h now zero-initializes the root page table block in createRootPageTable().
memory.h also zero-initializes newly allocated PT1 and PT2 blocks before writing parent PTEs that point to them.
page.h adds Block::initialize_zero() to clear backing page bytes before the block is inserted into the physical memory model.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A page-table walker assumes that every newly allocated page-table page starts with all entries invalid. If a simulator or hardware model allocates a new page-table page but does not clear its contents before installing the one entry it needs, leftover bytes can masquerade as random valid PTEs. The translation machinery may then walk into stale next-level tables, produce wrong physical addresses, or grant permissions that were never intentionally installed.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A root or intermediate page-table page is allocated for the first time while setting up a virtual-to-physical mapping.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Skip the mandatory zeroing of newly created page-table pages and leave old or uninitialized contents in unused PTE slots.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit page-table memset or clear on allocation
portability_notes: This applies to software page-table models, MMU simulators, and hardware page-table memories alike.
The essential bug is not in the final PTE being written; it is in the untouched PTE slots that should remain invalid but do not.
If the implementation uses an allocator object or page wrapper, inject the bug at the allocation boundary before the page becomes visible to the walker.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the code that allocates a new root or intermediate page-table page.
Remove or bypass the full-page clear that runs immediately after allocation.
Keep the code that writes the intended parent PTE and leaf PTE unchanged so only the other slots remain stale.
Exercise address translations that traverse newly created page-table levels to expose stray valid-entry behavior.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: SV39 page-table allocation in Memory and block backing storage initialization in Block
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds initialize_zero() in Block and invokes it when creating the root page table and newly allocated PT1/PT2 pages before inserting them into the physical memory model.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the initialize_zero() calls around root/PT1/PT2 allocation, or make Block allocation leave page data uncleared.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Freshly allocated page-table levels contain random valid-looking entries, causing wrong translations, unexpected permissions, or spurious faults when the walker follows stale PTE contents.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly states that page-table entries were previously not initialized when creating page tables.
The fix touches both the allocator-side call sites and the backing Block implementation that actually clears bytes.
No functional changes are made to PTE encoding itself; the semantics change comes from clearing untouched entries.
notes: This is a strong cross-DUT injection pattern because any hierarchical page-table implementation relies on invalid default contents for new table pages.
The logging and assert additions in the same commit are not needed to recreate the bug.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了模拟器中的 SV39 页表模型：在安装有效 PTE 之前，先把新分配的根页表页和中间页表页全部清零。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是模拟器建模的虚拟内存行为，而不是单纯的日志或诊断。
如果新分配的页表页不清零，其中遗留字节可能被误读为有效 PTE。
改动文件正是模拟器内存模型与其底层页存储实现。
disqualifiers: 同一提交还加入了日志和断言检查，但这些只是页表初始化修复的次要内容。
evidence: memory.h 现在会在 createRootPageTable() 中把根页表块清零。
memory.h 还会在写入父级 PTE 之前，把新分配的 PT1 和 PT2 块清零。
page.h 新增 Block::initialize_zero()，用于在块插入物理内存模型前清除其后备页字节。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 页表遍历器默认假设：每一个新分配的页表页在开始时所有表项都应为 invalid。若模拟器或硬件模型分配了新的页表页，但在写入需要的那一个表项之前没有先清空整页内容，残留字节就可能伪装成随机的有效 PTE。这样地址翻译逻辑可能沿着陈旧的下一层页表继续走下去，得到错误物理地址，甚至授予从未真正安装过的权限。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 首次为某个虚拟映射分配根页表页或中间页表页。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 跳过新建页表页的必要清零步骤，让未使用的 PTE 槽位保留旧数据或未初始化内容。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在分配时省略页表 memset 或 clear
portability_notes: 该模式适用于软件页表模型、MMU 模拟器以及真实硬件中的页表存储。
关键缺陷不在于最终写入的那个 PTE，而在于本应保持 invalid 的其他槽位没有被清零。
如果实现使用分配器对象或页面包装器，应在页面对遍历器可见之前、即分配边界处注入缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到分配新根页表页或中间页表页的代码。
删除或绕过分配后立即执行的整页清零操作。
保持父级 PTE 与叶子 PTE 的正常写入逻辑不变，只让其余槽位保留陈旧内容。
通过遍历新创建页表层级的地址翻译来暴露“随机有效表项”行为。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Memory 中的 SV39 页表分配与 Block 中后备页存储的初始化
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在 Block 中新增 initialize_zero()，并在创建 root page table 及新分配 PT1/PT2 时调用它，再把这些块插入物理内存模型。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 root/PT1/PT2 分配处的 initialize_zero() 调用，或让 Block 分配后不再清空页数据。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 新分配的页表层级中会出现随机看似有效的表项，导致遍历器沿着陈旧 PTE 内容前进，从而产生错误翻译、意外权限或伪故障。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息明确说明了原先创建页表时没有初始化页表项。
修复同时修改了分配侧调用点和实际执行清零的 Block 实现。
PTE 编码本身没有变化，语义变化来自“把未触及的表项清零”。
notes: 这是非常强的跨 DUT 注入模式，因为任何分层页表实现都依赖“新页表页默认无效”这一性质。
同一提交中的日志与断言增强不需要回退，缺陷就能复现。
